faq.q: What is Cipher Mall in GTA 6?
faq.a: Cipher Mall is a shopping center listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Cipher Mall confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Cipher Mall as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Cipher Mall?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: shopping center. Scope: single site. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Cipher Mall information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Cipher Mall, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Cipher Mall?
faq.a: Most of it. Cipher Mall rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Where it sits on the map and whether the player can go inside are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Cipher Mall be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of landmark entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
